Testing python chunk execution in Rstudio (instructions below)

```{r, load_reticulate}
library(reticulate)
```

```{python, create_object}
testing_object = 44
```

```{python, change_object}
testing_object = testing_object + 11
```

1: in the following chunk, click on the arrow to "run all chunks above".  
2: inside the chunk double-click on `testing_object` to mark it.  
3: press CTRL/CMD + ENTER to check if you can directly see 55.  

```{python, test_object, echo=TRUE}
testing_object
```

If this is not the case, check this [issue](https://github.com/rstudio/rstudio/issues/17196) on Mac for a workaround.

If you can see this rendered with a colorful plot, continue in step 6 (Exercises).
